items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] and Miroslav Vitous. [INTERVIEWEE] Now He Sings, Now He Sobs. I thought that was a fabulous record.

ctx.x: A lot of Stevie’s music. Yeah, absolutely. Chick . . . actually I think one of my favorite records of all time is probably that Chick Corea record with. . . I can’t think of the name of it right now . . . with Roy Haynes . . .
Now He Sings, Now He Sobs. I thought that was a fabulous record. And it made me . . . Is it one of your favorites?
